# Fancy Corner Online

Fancy Corner Online is a Coimbatore-based retail brand focused on toys, craft products, RC cars and miniature/vintage-style cars.

Website: https://zenventora.github.io/FS-website/
Address: No.12, Bilal Estate, South Ukkadam, Coimbatore – 641001, Tamil Nadu, India
Phone/WhatsApp: +91 79046 39830
Email: fancycorneronline@gmail.com

Ordering is handled directly through WhatsApp. Product Buy Now opens a WhatsApp conversation with the selected product details. The cart can combine multiple products before opening the final WhatsApp message.
